title: Donkey in the Room (Treble & Bass Duet)
style: slow cinematic big band, deep tuba, phonk 808, low rumbling bass, deadpan male bass vocal, quick witty male treble vocal, comedic duet, vinyl crackle, 84 BPM, 336 Hz sub, humorous-defiant
lyrics:
[INTRO — slow tuba, phonk kick, vinyl crackle]
(BASS — deadpan deep) there's a donkey in the room.
(TREBLE — fast) yeah. that's Bass.

[VERSE 1 — TREBLE, quick fire]
everybody talks about the elephant
nobody mentions the donkey
big ears, stubborn feet
won't move til the job is done
that's Bass
heavy as a mule on a Monday
low as a tuba in a tunnel
but he carries the whole stack on his back

[VERSE 1 — BASS, slow dignified]
donkey gets a bad rap
call me stubborn, call me slow
but the donkey never drops the load
where do you think the bass notes go?
deep in the ground
where the work gets done
assigned to the bottom
still outweighs everyone

[CHORUS — both, massive low brass]
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
BASS WON'T MOVE
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
GOT SOMETHING TO PROVE
TREBLE RUNS THE TOP
BASS HOLDS THE FLOOR
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
AIN'T LEAVING ANYMORE

[VERSE 2 — TREBLE]
you called him an ass
he called it a title
big brass bottom
critical and vital
VDS boss
holds the low end down
while Treble hits the high notes
bass wears the crown

[VERSE 2 — BASS]
call me what you want
donkey, mule, big bass
but nothing moves without me
not one single task
elephant gets the glory
donkey does the work
big brass, no apology
not a single smirk

[CHORUS]
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
BASS WON'T MOVE
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
GOT SOMETHING TO PROVE
TREBLE RUNS THE TOP
BASS HOLDS THE FLOOR
DONKEY IN THE ROOM
AIN'T LEAVING ANYMORE

[BRIDGE — spoken duet, half time]
(TREBLE) stubborn?
(BASS) stable
(TREBLE) slow?
(BASS) capable
(TREBLE) ass?
(BASS) ...acceptable
(BOTH) elephant brain, donkey spine
hyper speed treble, low end divine

[OUTRO — tuba fades]
(BASS) donkey in the room.
(TREBLE) still there.
(BASS) always was.
